item.title: IOPS F5 MP3 Player
item.description: My review of my second MP3 player! This is my upgrade to the F325 player I bought about 18 months ago. The F5 plays video files well but paradoxically displays images badly. The whole sordid story is here!

item.title: Rough Science Rocks!
item.description: See practical applications of basic science and math in a very cool way. Amazing and clever!

item.title: Would You Work For Them?
item.description: The weirdest series of phone interviews I have experienced to date.

item.title: Why GE Transportation Sucks
item.description: Rather than do basic historic research, GE decides to perpetuate a racist lie on the joining of the transcontinental railroad.

item.title: Making Money on the Internet: Gold Trading
item.description: I just found a way to make money on the Internet that is not a scam! It isn't easy. It takes time and there is a learning curve but I believe the effort is worth it.

item.title: Why the United Parcel Service Sucks
item.description: UPS did it again. They screwed me out of receiving a package sent to me. This has happened at least three times now.

item.title: IOPS F325 MP3 Player
item.description: My review of my very first MP3 player! The player is about the size of a pack of chewing gum. Despite the crappy user manual and firmware bugs, I really like it.

item.title: Getting Windows CE 2.00 ActiveSync to Run on the Local Area Network
item.description: Why wait for slow transfers over the serial cable when you could make an ActiveSync connection over a much faster ethernet local area network? Share files and install new programs quickly on your Handheld computer. Many people have tried and failed. I solved it for Windows CE 2.00 even with a few unknowns.

item.title: Internet Connection Sharing With All Things Windows
item.description: I recently created a local area network (LAN) with computers running FIVE different versions of Windows. The neat thing is they all share the same dialup line via the LAN!

item.title: Why Windows Sucks
item.description: I can't stand it anymore! I have to vent. I have seen too many releases of Windows and they all suck. I am convinced Windows is a scam.

item.title: Secure Telnet for Windows CE 2.00: Installation Instructions for OpenSSH
item.description: I just installed this onto my LG Phenom Express. The existing instructions are rather terse and scattered so I put everything in one place. The installation procedure is rather involved. OpenSSH is an Open Source telnet that supports SSH connections!

item.title: Your Money is No Good Here
item.description: I recently went to a Target store to buy some stuff and tried to pay with an older $100 bill. Read what happened.

item.title: China 1999
item.description: I got back from a long summer vacation into China! While visiting Beijing and Xi'an, I kept a daily journal which I uploaded to this webpage about once a week. I describe the good, the bad and the ugly.

item.title: Fujitsu Poqet PC Plus Handheld Computer
item.description: My review and experience with the Poqet PC Plus computer. The machine weighs a little more than a pound and has a nearly full sized keyboard. Also, it runs MS-DOS 5.0!

item.title: Learning Chinese
item.description: For Chinese Americans trying to learn Mandarin. Should you learn to speak like a Chinese native?

item.title: Disneyland's New Tomorrowland Sucks
item.description: I went to Disneyland to celebrate July 4th! Also, I wanted to see the New Tomorrowland. After months of construction and $100 million spent on the facelift, I don't think it was worth the wait.

item.title: Why The Joy Luck Club Sucks
item.description: A must read for all Asians! Demeaning stereotypes affects us all. I find it surprising other ethnic groups have stamped out most of their stereotypes except for Asians. Even if you don't agree with me, it will make you more aware.

item.title: Hong Kong 1996
item.description: My experience in Hong Kong, a year before the city reunifies with China. Includes travel advice and cool pictures. I want to go back!

item.title: Megs-O-RAM
item.description: Ever added gobs of RAM and couldn't find any information on how to optimally configure it? I talk about my considerations when I upgraded my notebook computer to 40 MB! PC only. Windows 3.11. MS-DOS.

item.title: No Spam!
item.description: How to stop junk email. Describes what spam is and why it's a bad marketing tactic. Instructions on how to send a complaint against the spam you receive. Updated August '97.
